limitations: Three fresh implicit NEAR wallets, one trace arm, against the previous frozen stored-ID candidate.
Gateway D1 calls only. Console and Rust custody databases are outside this observer.
Address-read duration includes the regional deployment write check in the same D1 batch.
Elapsed D1 time includes network and SQL. Sums can overlap and are not critical-path durations.
Background calls unfinished at response are reported as pending. Later calls are outside the response trace.
The observer uses all() for first() to retain metadata, with the same SQL and one query. This is diagnostic evidence, not a new latency comparison.
